description: This file is a PHP source code for a Wi-Fi Spectrum Analyzer web interface. It includes PHP scripts, HTML markup, CSS styles, and JavaScript code, handling the user interface for scanning Wi-Fi spectra, displaying results, and saving data.

methods.name: spanTable
methods.description: Recursively merges table cells with identical content in a specified range to create a span effect in the spectrum analyzer table.

methods.name: ajax_spec_analyzer
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to fetch Wi-Fi spectrum data, processes and displays the results in the table, and manages UI state during the scan.
